symptoms.name: Pump runs, but no water delivered
symptoms.quote: Pump runs, but no water delivered

causes.name: Mechanical C. Pump lost prime
causes.fix: Reprime. Inspect suction system for air leaks.
causes.quote: C. Pump lost prime. Reprime. Inspect suction system for air leaks.

causes.name: System A. Pressure required by system at design flow rate exceeds pressure rating of pump
causes.fix: Compare pump pressure and flow rate against pump characteristic curve. Check for closed or partially closed valve in discharge piping system. Reduce system pressure requirement. Increase pressure capability of pump.
causes.quote: A. Pressure required by system at design flow rate exceeds pressure rating of pump. Compare pump pressure and flow rate against pump characteristic curve. Check for closed or partially closed valve in discharge piping system. Reduce system pressure requirement. Increase pressure capability of pump.

causes.name: Electrical A. No voltage in power system
causes.fix: Check phase-to-phase on line side of starter contactor.
causes.quote: A. No voltage in power system. Check phase-to-phase on line side of starter contactor.

causes.name: Electrical B. No voltage on one phase (Three Phase units)
causes.fix: Check circuit breaker or fuses. Check phase voltage on line side of starter contactor. Isolate open circuit (circuit breaker, fuse, broken connections, etc.)
causes.quote: B. No voltage on one phase (Three Phase units). Check circuit breaker or fuses. Check phase voltage on line side of starter contactor. Isolate open circuit (circuit breaker, fuse, broken connections, etc.)

causes.name: Electrical C. Low voltage at motor
causes.fix: Running voltage across each leg of motor must be ±10% of nominal voltage shown on nameplate.
causes.quote: C. Low voltage at motor. Running voltage across each leg of motor must be ±10% of nominal voltage shown on nameplate.

causes.name: Electrical D. Motor leads improperly grouped for voltage
causes.fix: Refer to lead grouping diagram on motor nameplate.
causes.quote: D. Motor leads improperly grouped for voltage. Refer to lead grouping diagram on motor nameplate.

causes.name: Electrical E. Control failure
causes.fix: Check control device, starter contactor, H-O-A selector switch, etc., for malfunction.
causes.quote: E. Control failure. Check control device, starter contactor, H-O-A selector switch, etc., for malfunction.

causes.name: Electrical F. Thermal overload switch open
causes.fix: Check phase-to-phase on line side of starter contactor.
causes.quote: F. Thermal overload switch open Check phase-to-phase on line side of starter contactor.

causes.name: Electrical G. Installation failure
causes.fix: Check motor or windings to ground with megohmmeter.
causes.quote: G. Installation failure. Check motor or windings to ground with megohmmeter.

causes.name: Electrical H. Open windings
causes.fix: Check leg-to-leg with ohmmeter.
causes.quote: H. Open windings. Check leg-to-leg with ohmmeter.
